svg.title: MedScale medium-size icon - dark
svg.desc: Optical medium-size master (48 to 64 px): the approved geometry with a heavier stroke, centered on a solid square. The operating system may apply its own mask.
svg.metadata: MedScale identity. Symbol: Logo 12 three-frame mark, founder-approved 2026-10-19, first-party vector reconstruction. Wordmark: founder-approved 2026-10-22, filled outlines drawn from Plus Jakarta Sans (SIL OFL 1.1) with custom spacing. No font file is embedded.
